description: W.G. Alwis v. Shabir Omar W.G. Alwis v. Shabir Omar View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: W.G. Alwis v. Shabir Omar W.G. Alwis v. Shabir Omar View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to have an ex-parte action declared abated under Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code, arguing that the Respondent failed to take steps to serve the decree. Held - once an ex-parte decree is entered, the action is concluded and service of the decree is not a step necessary to prosecute the action; Petitioner lacked locus standi until the default was purged. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
